close_reason: citation and evaluated_at_unix added to Finding; cert_sha256/bundle_version deferred to v0.3 with doc note
description:
The current Finding struct (lint_id, result, cert_index) lacks the metadata needed for an 'evidence pack' export: a one-click bundle containing cert + path + findings + rule citations + rule provenance that operators can attach to CA help-desk tickets.

Add to Finding or to a new EvaluationReport wrapper:
- rule_citation: &'static str (already in Lint::citation(), just needs threading through)
- rule_bundle_version: &'static str (e.g. 'pkix-lint/cabf_tls_br v0.2.0, sourced from TLS BR SC-081')
- evaluated_at_unix: u64 (when was the lint run)
- cert_sha256: [u8; 32] (hash of the DER cert this finding applies to)

The evidence pack format is: JSON export of EvaluationReport, structured so SIEM/GRC tools can ingest it. OSCAL Assessment Results is the target schema for federal customers.

This is the highest-leverage feature for the CA ticket-filing workflow: eliminates the 'send me the cert details' round-trip.
title: pkix-lint: Finding struct needs provenance metadata for evidence pack export
